model.exactness: same ordered valid/ready transactions; no arithmetic
model.channel_capacity: same die-link ports; frame grows p2r3 300x300 to 360x360
model.area_basis: pre-build allowance 0.6 um2/FF including mux/route; mapping must measure
model.floorplan: disjoint row/site pin banks <=16um inward, <=12um along face; FIRM through DPL
model.composed_delta_ns: 2 * (writes + fences) / clock_ghz; sum actual trace events, no headline adoption
model.evidence_gate: full-width original fence transaction bench and mutants + TT/FF/DRC closure

calendar_qualification: reactive environments use different random seeds; serial script latency evidence, not a pure fixed timing delta
physical_qualification: not measured; admitted job required; default off
